rule.head_region: upper60% of bbox_from_mask(supplied miner mask), identical bbox coordinates to existing helmet_geometry; rasterize pixel centers; clip bounds; no dilation
rule.accept: both nonempty and S_AA>0 and S_BB>0 and both margins>0; otherwise ABSTAIN_ESCALATE; ties abstain
rule.after_failure: AUROC>=.75: later training-only calibration may be considered; AUROC<.75: stop Layer2 development
